reason: Build v0.1.2 after real-device v0.1.1 proved that moving cgi-io O_TMPFILE to overlay forces cross-filesystem fallback copying into /tmp/firmware.bin and triggers a new OOM. Keep only Nginx request-body buffering on disk; restore cgi-io O_TMPFILE to /tmp so cgi-io and /tmp/firmware.bin share the same tmpfs and can use linkat without a second 90+ MiB copy. Keep the verified v0.1.0 Known-Good source lock unchanged.
